{
  "name": "nestjs-pino",
  "version": "5.3.1",
  "description": "Pino logger for NestJS",
  "main": "./dist/cjs/index.js",
  "types": "./dist/cjs/index.d.ts",
  "exports": {
    ".": {
      "import": {
        "types": "./dist/esm/index.d.ts",
        "default": "./dist/esm/index.js"
      },
      "require": {
        "types": "./dist/cjs/index.d.ts",
        "default": "./dist/cjs/index.js"
      }
    },
    "./package.json": "./package.json"
  },
  "sideEffects": false,
  "scripts": {
    "test": "vitest run",
    "lint": "tsc --noemit && biome check src __tests__ example",
    "lint:fix": "tsc --noemit && biome check --write src __tests__ example",
    "prebuild": "rimraf dist",
    "build": "tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p tsconfig.build.esm.json && echo '{\"type\":\"module\"}' > dist/esm/package.json",
    "example": "rimraf dist && tsc && LOG_LEVEL=debug node dist/example/main"
  },
  "files": [
    "dist"
  ],
  "engines": {
    "node": ">=22.12.0"
  },
  "repository": {
    "type": "git",
    "url": "git+https://github.com/iamolegga/nestjs-pino.git"
  },
  "keywords": [
    "pino",
    "nestjs",
    "nest.js",
    "nest",
    "logger"
  ],
  "author": "iamolegga <iamolegga@gmail.com> (http://github.com/iamolegga)",
  "license": "MIT",
  "bugs": {
    "url": "https://github.com/iamolegga/nestjs-pino/issues"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/iamolegga/nestjs-pino#readme",
  "devDependencies": {
    "@biomejs/biome": "^2.5.11",
    "@nestjs/common": "^12.1.2",
    "@nestjs/core": "^12.1.2",
    "@nestjs/microservices": "^12.1.2",
    "@nestjs/platform-express": "^12.1.2",
    "@nestjs/platform-fastify": "^12.1.2",
    "@nestjs/testing": "^12.1.2",
    "@swc/core": "^1.16.1",
    "@types/express": "^5.0.6",
    "@types/memorystream": "^0.3.4",
    "@types/node": "^26.4.0",
    "@types/supertest": "^7.2.1",
    "@vitest/coverage-v8": "^5.0.0",
    "memorystream": "^0.3.1",
    "pino": "^10.3.1",
    "pino-http": "^11.0.0",
    "reflect-metadata": "^0.2.2",
    "rimraf": "^6.1.3",
    "rxjs": "^7.8.2",
    "supertest": "^7.2.2",
    "typescript": "^7.0.2",
    "unplugin-swc": "^2.0.0",
    "vitest": "^5.0.0"
  },
  "peerDependencies": {
    "@nestjs/common": "^11.0.8 || ^12.0.2",
    "@nestjs/core": "^11.0.8 || ^12.0.2",
    "pino": "^10.0.0",
    "pino-http": "^11.0.0",
    "rxjs": "^7.1.0"
  }
}
